name: vwap reclaim with trend
note: Execution algos benchmarked to VWAP resume buying once price clears it to avoid tracking error, while short sellers using VWAP as fair value are proven wrong and must cover into strength.

name: ema10/30 golden cross
note: Systematic trend funds run this exact crossover as a buy trigger in size; discretionary shorts positioned for the old trend have stops just above and get squeezed into covering, adding fuel.

name: vol expansion in uptrend [target 5]
note: Short-vol and range-selling strategies are structurally short gamma; when realized volatility breaks above its longer baseline during an uptrend, they must buy back into the acceleration, amplifying it.

name: vwap_oversold_bounce
note: Execution algos benchmarked to VWAP dump size below fair value on a schedule regardless of price; once their sell clock runs out, traders who shorted the weakness late must buy back into a thin book as price snaps to VWAP.

name: vol_compression_uptrend
note: Vol-targeting funds size positions off recent realized volatility; when short-term vol drops below the longer baseline inside an uptrend, they are mechanically underweight and must add exposure as it re-expands, buying regardless of price level.

name: trend_momentum_continuation_long
note: Trend-following CTAs re-add on any positive short-term push once price sits above the longer trend average; discretionary traders who shorted expecting a pullback have a fixed loss limit and must cover as the trend funds keep buying.

name: downtrend_pullback_reclaim [target 5]
note: Same mechanism inverted: systematic sell programs fire when price loses the short average inside a bigger downtrend, and bounce-buyers who bought the rally get flushed as that flow hits at once.
